verdict.rationale: Zapier ships an official CLI (Platform CLi for building integrations) and specifically a newer Zapier SDK CLI designed for AI-native use — letting agents/developers explore and run actions across apps directly from the terminal with authentication handled automatically, positioned explicitly as agent-friendly tooling alongside npm/MCP discovery. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the SDK CLI in agentic workflows, and more detail on agent-specific invocation patterns beyond first-party docs.
